claims.text: The DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room posts 37 files whose names begin 'Defense_Intelligence_Reference_Document_'. 32 of those have been retrieved and their cover pages transcribed; DIA document numbers, publication dates and Intelligence Cut-Off Dates are recorded on the individual document nodes.

DIA document numbers follow the pattern DIA-08-YYMM-NNN, where 08 ties to the FY2008 program start and YYMM is the production month — e.g. DIA-08-0911-016 (Nov 2009), DIA-08-1003-015 (Mar 2010), DIA-08-1102-007 (Feb 2011 batch). The numbering is sparse in the released set, which indicates the released DIRDs are not the complete numbered series.

Confirmed unreachable in this pass: 5 of the 37 DIRD filenames listed by DIA have no resolvable FileId URL — Biomaterials; Materials_For_Advanced_Aerospace_Platforms; Metallic_Glasses_For_Aerospace_Applications; Metallic_Spintronics; Metamaterials_For_Aerospace_Applications. The complete Wayback CDX index for dia.mil FOIA reading-room FileId URLs (3,536 unique FileIds) contains no snapshot of them, and the live page does not expose FileIds to a text fetcher.

edges.note: Authorship, corroborated internally rather than only by the DIA list. References 3, 16 and 19 of the paper are Puthoff's own prior work, and DIA singled the report out as its showcase deliverable in Info Memo U-10-2552 to USD(AT&L).

edges.label: Wayne State clinician authored the AAWSAP human-effects reference document
edges.note: Green, while a Wayne State professor, wrote the Defense Intelligence Reference Document 'Anomalous Acute and Subacute Field Effects on Human and Biological Tissues' for the DIA-funded AAWSAP contract; DIA released it with the other DIRDs in 2022. Tier 2 because the work was Green's, commissioned through BAASS, not a Wayne State institutional contract.
